verdict.rationale: A probe confirms the smolagents docs are served as machine-readable markdown (guided_tour.md returns HTTP 200 with the page content), so an agent can be pointed at plain-text docs. However, the llms.txt probe returned 404, and nothing documents an agent-oriented docs index or guidance. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, documented agent-oriented docs entry points, first-party documentation of the markdown endpoints, independent corroboration of agents using the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
